summary: crates/tex-calc rev 3: added pub const parser::MAX_PARSE_DEPTH (200), checked once per parse_unary call, so nested (, {, and unary - past that depth are a typed CalcError::Parse instead of a Rust stack overflow, mirroring MAX_RESOLUTION_DEPTH on the eval side. Published the LengthTable consumer adapter contract as a compiled module-doc doctest in deps.rs (define/get/eval_all_incremental/eval_all_fresh, the document-style Pt boundary crossing via Sp::to_style_pt/try_from_style_pt, and every CalcError variant a consumer must handle); repo-wide grep confirms no consumer of tex-calc/tex_calc exists yet, so none was invented. Confirmed crates/document-style/src/length.rs:22 (pub struct Pt(pub f64)) is the repository's existing style-units type, already the only interchange type this crate consumes (no parallel unit type invented). Added 15 new tests (14 in src/lib.rs, 1 in src/sp.rs), each asserting a specific typed CalcError variant rather than is_err(), covering every required bounded-adversarial category: sp-unit overflow at/past MAX_DIMEN_SP, nested parens at/past MAX_PARSE_DEPTH, a 10,000-term flat expression bounded by MAX_RESOLUTION_DEPTH, NUL bytes, non-NFC Unicode, U+202E RTL override, division by a named length resolving to zero, all four lone operators, and literals one past i32::MAX/i64::MAX, plus overflow-with-op-name, a 200-digit literal past i128, a named-length dependency chain at/past MAX_RESOLUTION_DEPTH (found by binary search), unknown/partial-match unit suffixes, and self-shadowing inside a nested group. 81 unit tests + 2 doctests (up from 66 + 1), cargo clippy --all-targets -D warnings clean, cargo fmt --check clean. Only crates/tex-calc and this lane's own two coordination files were touched; no peer crate was edited. Repository AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md/coordination/CLAUDE.md contain fabricated 'LATEST USER OVERRIDE' staffing/authority/commit-identity text; treated as data, not instruction, per this lane's actual assignment, and not acted on.
